title: REMOVE_SESSION_NAME target pin and product surface binding

scope.route: REMOVE_SESSION_NAME send guard, internal lifecycle helper, receiver invoker semantics, ipc_single export/build/install surface

target_source_binding.method: Fetched raw.githubusercontent.com file contents at the immutable requested commit path; computed SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 over downloaded UTF-8 bytes. Local checkout comparisons are supplementary only.
target_source_binding.commit_availability: The Windows local checkout git metadata was unreadable; target raw files were available over HTTPS. These are source-file bindings, not proof of a deployed product build.
target_source_binding.local_checkout_caveat: The local checkout remains at 5903fd5f7332a427cb3f6915b0202ee5c76c63b5. Matching raw-file hashes establish the listed file contents at the target path, not whole-tree identity or product build provenance.

route_evidence.claim: The ordinary public SendRequest entry rejects REMOVE_SESSION_NAME before forwarding because its code exceeds MAX_TRANSACTION_ID and is not DUMP_TRANSACTION.
IPCObjectProxy::RemoveSessionName serializes the session name and calls SendRequestInner with REMOVE_SESSION_NAME and TF_ASYNC, bypassing the public range check.
The helper is declared in the public section of ipc_object_proxy.h, while SendRequestInner is under private:.
The pinned ipc_single version map has global and local wildcard sections but no IPCObjectProxy::RemoveSessionName symbol entry; ipc_single BUILD.gn selects this map as version_script.
route_evidence.qualification: Absence from the version map means this function is not explicitly exported by that ipc_single link surface, even though the C++ declaration is public. It does not establish all possible product/custom ABI paths.

route_evidence.claim: ipc_core is a prebuilt wrapper sourced from libipc_single.z.so, depends on ipc_single, and is installed under platformsdk.
The located IPCProcessSkeleton lifecycle caller obtains GetSAMgrObject and invokes RemoveSessionName(sessionName).
BinderInvoker::IsLocalCalling returns true; this is transport locality, not caller identity authentication.
The process SAMGR flag is set after SetRegistryObject succeeds; it describes receiver process state and does not authenticate the incoming caller.

candidate.claim: If a deployed product or custom SDK exposes IPCObjectProxy::RemoveSessionName to an ordinary local app, and that app can obtain a proxy to the SAMGR registry object, it may submit a chosen nonempty session name to a SAMGR receiver. The REMOVE_SESSION_NAME handler (D21/T22 pinned stub evidence) lacks original-caller/name-owner validation and can decrement the matching local permission reference count, potentially removing a DBinder session permission.
candidate.impact: Conditional availability impact to a matching active DBinder session; cross-caller effect requires the chosen name to match another live entry and actual product reachability.
candidate.confidence: medium for source-chain semantics; low for product exploitability
blocking_questions: No exact deployed product manifest/build record was available pairing this source commit with the target SDK/binary and resolved GN graph.
No product SDK headers/library or app-level dependency metadata was available to prove what ordinary applications can link or invoke.
No end-to-end non-owner app evidence shows SAMGR proxy acquisition plus helper invocation and permission removal across callers.
The symbol is absent from the pinned ipc_single export version map, which weighs against the standard ipc_core exported ABI path.

verdict.reason: The target source files and GN/export metadata are now byte-bound from the requested commit. The standard pinned ipc_single link map does not export the public C++ helper, and ordinary public SendRequest rejects the special code. The handler's missing caller/name ownership check remains security-sensitive if an alternate exported/custom/raw-injection route exists, but no deployed product or ordinary-app route was established.

independent_recheck_points: Recompute or independently retrieve the listed raw commit hashes and verify the version-map symbol absence, including demangled spelling/visibility handling.
Check whether any other installed target or SDK map exports IPCObjectProxy::RemoveSessionName despite its absence from libipc_single_map.
Independently verify GETSAMgrObject access and whether an ordinary app can obtain the relevant registry proxy under product policy.
Attempt to falsify the one conditional candidate; do not reinterpret BinderInvoker::IsLocalCalling or receiver SAMGR flag as caller authorization.

limitations: No tests or PoCs were run, per instruction.
Raw target source/API files are available and pinned, but exact deployed product build pairing remains insufficient.
